messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Hospital Course:

The patient, a 68-year-old man, underwent laparoscopic low anterior resection for rectal cancer. The patient's preoperative diagnosis was stage IIIB rectal cancer. Preoperative imaging showed a shortened mesentery of the descending colon due to adhesion of the sigmoid colon to the mesentery of the small intestine. During the laparoscopic procedure, the IMA, LCA, and IMV were ligated. The patient experienced no complications in their postoperative course.

Procedures: Laparoscopic low anterior resection 

Hospital Course: The patient underwent a laparoscopic low anterior resection for their stage IIIB rectal cancer. During the procedure, the IMA, LCA, and IMV were ligated. The patient tolerated the procedure well and experienced no complications during their postoperative course. 

Discharge Instructions: The patient is advised to follow up with their primary care provider and oncologist as scheduled. They are encouraged to maintain a nutritious diet and to engage in physical activity as recommended by their healthcare providers. 

Follow-Up: The patient is recommended to follow up with their healthcare providers as scheduled.
